dimensions.assessment: Affects grandfamilies, kinship families, community-based organizations, and government programs serving these populations.
dimensions.evidence: provide training, technical assistance, coordination, and resources to community-based organizations, government programs, and other organizations that serve grandfamilies and kinship families

dimensions.assessment: Provides targeted technical assistance and resources to support caregiving families, particularly where caregivers are age 55 or older or children have disabilities.
dimensions.evidence: focus primarily on serving grandfamilies or kinship families in which the primary caregiver is an adult age 55 or older
